title: A live blog of the Google I/O 2026 keynote, where the company is set to announce the "latest AI breakthroughs and updates" in Gemini, Android, and more (Abner Li/9to5Google)
summary: Abner Li / 9to5Google: A live blog of the Google I/O 2026 keynote, where the company is set to announce the “latest AI breakthroughs and updates” in Gemini, Android, and more — I/O 2026 kicks off today as Google's biggest event of the year to showcase what's new for users and developers.
